items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Baby Dot. John, what's the guy in California now?

ctx.x: For the booking agent. For the group. For the group, really.

Now we are... Peter Ron never was a member of our band. Peter Booker was a member of our band. He played violin. Yeah. But at this time they make this picture. Peter Ron was a member of our band at that time. He never was. Now you're showing the name of your son of the cornet players? Oh yes. What do you mean? Louis Armstrong. Mark Carey. When did you work with Armstrong? Just... never was a member. But he jobbed around with us in Southern Standard Place at times. He was young. He was very young. He hadn't…
St. Sarah in the band, on the band, John?

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Well all the other played with us played six string.

ctx.x: You remember Bud Scott and Johnny Saint-Cyr both played those six string bandages? Six string.
Well all the other played with us played six string. We never did have a first string. Who were they?
Who were some of the men that played six string?
